Microbial habitats, harmonized

The same habitat has three different names depending on who is describing it. HabitatMech resolves them onto one ontology-grounded record and keeps every source's own account of it.

What HabitatMech adds

HabitatMech is not a re-labelling of ENVO. Most of what it holds, ENVO has no term for — and a concept that merely hangs under an ENVO term counts as new, because the identifier is minted precisely when the matched term is broader than the concept.

What the grounding status means

Every record says how well its identifier fits the source concept, separately from the recorded curation workflow status. A record can be reviewed and still honestly ungrounded — that combination is a well-formed request for a new ontology term, and there are 701 of them.

GROUNDING STATUS
STATUS	RECORDS	MEANING
EXACT	1049	The identifier is an exact match for the source concept.
NARROW	989	The identifier is narrower than the source concept.
UNGROUNDED	959	No defensible ontology term; a minted identifier and a term-request candidate.
NOT_APPLICABLE	107	Not a habitat at all — a disease, quality, process or procedure.
CLOSE	93	Close, but not exact and not cleanly broader or narrower.
BROAD	12	The identifier is broader — the best available term, losing specificity.

This corpus is machine-generated. 1908 of 3209 records have the SEEDED workflow status. The harmonization rules are documented and tested, but a lexical match between a source label and an ontology label is a plausible grounding, not a verified one.

REVIEWED records carry a recorded workflow decision, including agent-assisted curation. These counts do not establish human review. Consult the attributed curation events on each record for its provenance.

Data downloads & LinkML schema

All HabitatMech records, category search indexes, semantic embedding coordinates, and schema definitions are openly available:

LinkML Schema: src/habitatmech/schema/habitatmech.yaml (core habitat & causal graph schema), src/habitatmech/schema/mech_shared.yaml, and src/habitatmech/schema/history.yaml
Category JSON Indexes: host-associated.json (1655), engineered.json (488), aquatic.json (468), terrestrial.json (353), other.json (175), food.json (59), air.json (7), clinical.json (4)
Semantic Embedding Map Data: text-map-source/points.json and text-map-source/manifest.json
YAML Corpus & Term Requests: data/habitats/ (3209 YAML records) and data/term_requests.tsv
Connected X-Mech Knowledge Bases: TaxonMech (reported microbial taxa), CommunityMech (ecological communities), CultureMech (growth media), TraitMech (environmental stress & physiological traits), and X-Mech Suite

Generated from kg-microbe on 2026-08-16. Project data: CC BY 4.0; code: BSD-3-Clause · LinkML Schema · Downloads. Third-party terms apply.

Workflow status does not establish human review. Grounding is by lexical match against ontology labels except where a curation decision says otherwise; treat any record marked SEEDED as a starting point, not a citable claim. Current workflow counts.
